verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP hosts dedicated MCP servers for its own catalog of 3,000+ pre-built app integrations, with transport and auth handled for the developer. Nothing in the evidence shows a developer importing their own OpenAPI definition or custom code to generate a hosted MCP server. The proxy for endpoints without a pre-built tool is an adjacent feature: it forwards requests for catalog apps and does not turn a developer's API definition into an MCP server.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
